integrity: Theorem and code contain no claims of independent certification; finite checks and symbolic proof are separately identified.
scientific_limitations: Sorted incidence language only; case-analysis proof assumes the finite affine-plane axioms and q>=4. Finite checks confirm four coordinate examples, not infinitely many or non-Desarguesian cases. No independent audit and possible unindexed prior equivalences.
title: Three rank-four theories of finite affine planes with named point and line sorts
